correctness.rationale: Geometric fixed points are exactly the orbit-barycenter complex. The explicit quarter-turn square orbit formula produces two admissible alternatives for each unordered pair of antipodal index pairs, and no other four-square admissible orbit; compatibility is exactly matching disjointness. An odd-board center vertex supplies a cone. The integer BWW inflation splitting and known M7 homology yield the asserted Z/3 and free rank 461, and all smaller bases are torsion-free. Original-board enumeration and exact augmented integral Smith normal forms independently corroborate small cases. For n=2 the even fixed set is explicitly empty.
